text: <|emotion:anger|>I told you three times already, do not touch the archives without written permission!
target_aspect: Sharp vocal attack, increased pitch dynamics, aggressive cadence without clipping.

text: <|emotion:sadness|>I'm afraid there's nothing more we can do for the old manor. It's lost.
target_aspect: Subdued breathy phonation, lowered pitch contour, somber British cadence.

text: <|emotion:amusement|>You actually believed he rode an umbrella all the way to Paddington station?
target_aspect: Lighthearted pitch oscillation, suppressed chuckle in voice, cheerful lilt.

text: <|emotion:elation|>We won the fellowship! The entire grant has been approved unanimously!
target_aspect: High vocal energy, bright timbre, expansive pitch range without distortion.

text: <|style:whispering|>Keep your voice down... the night watchman is right around the corner.
target_aspect: Aphonic/breathy whispering, crisp unvoiced fricatives, intimate closeness.

text: <|style:shouting|>Look out below! The scaffold is collapsing!
target_aspect: Projected vocal power, strained intensity, controlled loudness without waveform clipping.

text: <|prosody:pitch_high|>Are you truly certain that little creature is harmless?
target_aspect: Elevated fundamental frequency (F0) shift while preserving natural cloned timbre.

text: <|prosody:speed_slow|>Every single detail... must be handled with utmost precision.
target_aspect: Extended vowel durations, measured deliberate delivery without robotic artifacting.

text: Well <|sfx:laughter|>, that is quite possibly the most ridiculous excuse I've ever heard in my life.
target_aspect: Natural integration of acoustic laughter token with continuous conversational flow.

text: <|sfx:sigh|> Another endless meeting that could have been resolved in a thirty-second email.
target_aspect: Audible exhalation/sigh followed by resigned British weary inflection.

text: <|sfx:cough|> Excuse me, the London fog seems particularly heavy this evening.
target_aspect: Dry cough paralinguistic sound followed by clear vocal recovery.

text: <|style:whispering|>Listen very carefully... <|style:shouting|>Run now, don't look back!
target_aspect: Dynamic range transition from intimate quiet whisper to urgent warning cry.

text: <|emotion:amusement|>I thought it was just a joke at first, <|emotion:anger|>until I saw you actually burned the contracts!
target_aspect: Shift from playful tone to sharp indignation and fury within a single utterance.

text: <|emotion:amusement|>Honestly, darling, <|sfx:laughter|> <|style:whispering|>you mustn't tell Lady Bracknell about this disaster just yet.
target_aspect: Multi-tag composition: amusement, paralinguistic laughter, and confidential whisper.
